// how this works: Every screenshot a page shows is listed here: the file name in ../video-editor/docs/screenshots (without .png) and its description for people who cannot see it. Only these are copied into the site.
editor_desktop: The ClipForge editor on a computer: a video preview with the title Summer 2026, a panel with Add media, Music, Overlay, Title, Captions and Split, and a timeline with a row of video clips, a green music row and an orange title row.
home_desktop: The project list on a computer: three projects called Summer trip, Garden and Birthday dinner, each with its length and date, and a New project button at the bottom right.
editor_desktop_empty: A new, empty project on a computer. The middle says This project is empty, with a button Add videos or photos.
tour_desktop_3_add-media: The built-in tour, step 3 of 8, pointing at the Add media button: Add media puts videos and photos into your video, after the selected clip or at the end.
tour_desktop_5_split: The built-in tour, step 5 of 8, pointing at the Split button: Split cuts the clip in two at the white line, the playhead.
editor_desktop_clip_selected: A video clip selected on the timeline, with handles at both ends. The panel on the right shows Done, Split, Freeze, Duplicate and Delete, and the Speed buttons from 0.25× to 4×.
editor_desktop_text_styles: A title selected on a computer. The panel shows ready-made styles (Classic, Bold outline, Boxed, Yellow subtitle, Elegant, Handwritten), four fonts, text colours, and switches for Bold, Dark box behind text, Outline and Shadow.
editor_desktop_captions: A caption reading Look at this! at the bottom of the picture. On the timeline two pink caption blocks sit under the clips, and a message says Added 2 captions.
editor_desktop_music: Music selected on the timeline. The panel shows Fade in, Fade out, the button Fit music to video, the track it is on, and the switch Lower Music under speech turned on.
editor_desktop_fit_music: After Fit music to video: the green music block now ends where the last clip ends, and a message says The music now ends with the video, with a 2-second fade-out.
editor_desktop_free_music: The Add music window on its Find free music tab, searching for happy. Three results show title, artist, length and licence, each with a play button and a Use button.
export_desktop_destination: The Export video window with Where is it going? Shorts / Reels / TikTok is chosen; ClipForge offers Make a copy in this shape or Export as it is, warns that the video is longer than 60 seconds, and shows the file size.
export_desktop_several: The Export several window with YouTube, Shorts / Reels / TikTok and Podcast audio ticked, each with the file name it will get, and a button Export 3 files.
export_desktop_finished: The Video saved window after an export on a computer: where the file was saved, the title and description with copy buttons, Show in folder, and a link Open YouTube upload page.
editor_desktop_silences: The Remove silences window: Found 2 silent gaps (1.9 s in total). Removing them shortens this clip from 6.0 s to 4.1 s. Buttons Cancel and Remove 2 gaps.
editor_desktop_speech_captions: The Captions from speech window on a computer: choose one or two lines and the longest line, see a preview of the captions, then Add captions.
editor_desktop_fillers: The Remove filler words window: a list of found um, er and uh with their times, each marked smooth, slight or jumpy, tick boxes, and the levels Light, Normal and Strong.
editor_desktop_speed: A clip set to 2× speed. The panel says Length 3.0 s (6.0 s at normal speed) and Voices keep their natural pitch.
markers_desktop: A talk on the timeline with a row of pink caption blocks. The panel on the right has Mark a good moment (M) and Good moments under Shorts and publishing.
short_dialog_desktop: The Make a short window: the selection is 7.3 seconds long, with ticks for Start and end at a pause, Short caption look and Title at the top, a title It needed salt, and the button Make the short.
short_made_desktop: The message The short is ready: Salt short is a new project in your project list, this video was not changed. Buttons Stay here and Open it.
editor_desktop_title_9x16: The same project in the upright 9:16 shape on a computer: the wide clip sits in the middle of a tall frame with the title Summer 2026 below it.
editor_desktop_crop: Crop on a computer: a 9:16 frame with a grid drawn over the wide picture, shape buttons Free, Original, 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5, Rotate and Flip buttons, and Position sliders.
text_window_desktop_wide: The Text window next to the preview: everything said in the video as a readable page, in paragraphs with the speakers' names Sam and Dana and a time at each paragraph, with a search box on top.
timeline_waves_desktop: A recorded conversation on the timeline: the video on top, then one voice track for Sam and one for Dana with their sound waves, bright where each one talks, and a green music track below.
publishing_notes_desktop: The Publishing notes window: Title, Description, Hashtags and Chapters, each with a copy button, the button Chapters from titles / captions, and a shorter title for Shorts, Reels and TikTok.
editor_desktop_overlay: An overlay selected: a second video as a small frame in the corner of the picture, with the layouts Picture-in-picture, Side by side, Top and bottom, Full screen and Free position.
editor_desktop_filters: The Look panel with the Vintage filter chosen: filters None, Warm, Cool, Black and white, Vintage and Vivid, sliders for Warmth, Brightness, Contrast, Saturation and Zoom in, and Fit, Fill or Blur.
connect_claude_desktop: The Connect to Claude page in ClipForge: The Claude helper is installed, with Test and Check again, then a card for Claude Desktop and one for Claude Code, each with a status light and a Connect button.
editor_phone: The ClipForge editor on a phone: the preview on top, the timeline with video, music and title rows below it, and a bar at the bottom with Add media, Music, Overlay, Title, Captions, Split and More.
home_phone: The project list on a phone: Summer trip, Garden and Birthday dinner, with a New project button at the bottom.
editor_phone_empty: A new, empty project on a phone: This project is empty, with the button Add videos or photos.
editor_phone_add: The Add sheet on a phone: Videos or photos, Music, Overlay (picture-in-picture), Title and Caption, each with a line saying where it goes.
tour_phone_5_split: The built-in tour on a phone, step 5 of 8, pointing at Split in the bottom bar.
editor_phone_title: Edit title on a phone: the text Summer 2026, a Text size slider, styles, fonts, text colours and a Bold switch.
editor_phone_caption_entry: Add caption on a phone: a box to type the line, a note that it appears at the playhead for 2.5 seconds, Import subtitles (.srt), and the Add button.
editor_phone_fit_music: Music selected on a phone: Volume, Fade in and Fade out sliders, and the button Fit music to video.
export_phone_destination: Export video on a phone with Where is it going? Shorts / Reels / TikTok is chosen, with Make a copy in this shape or Export as it is, and a warning about the 60-second limit.
export_phone_finished: Video saved on a phone: Saved to your gallery (Movies), the title and description with copy buttons, and the buttons Share, Copy title and description and Publishing notes.
editor_phone_silences: Remove silences on a phone: Found 2 silent gaps, removing them shortens the clip from 6.0 s to 4.1 s, with the button Remove 2 gaps.
editor_phone_speed: Speed on a phone: buttons from 0.25× to 4× with 2× chosen, an Any speed slider and Apply to all clips.
markers_phone: A talk on a phone with a caption And what did they say? on the picture and caption blocks on the timeline.
short_dialog_phone: Make a short on a phone: 30 seconds chosen, with Start and end at a pause, Short caption look and Title at the top ticked, and the button Make the short.
editor_phone_9x16: The editor on a phone with the upright 9:16 shape: a tall frame with the clip in the middle and the title Summer 2026 below it.
editor_phone_crop: Crop and position on a phone: a 9:16 frame over the wide picture, shape buttons, Rotate and Flip, and Position sliders.
